source_text: Educunt eum extra castra. Blasphemia expellitur. Ecclesia non communicat tenebris.
pass_a_gloss: They-lead him outside camp. Blasphemy is-expelled. Church not communes with-darkness.
pass_b_english: They [[bring him outside the camp >> Bible:Leviticus 24:14]]. Blasphemy is expelled. The church does not share with darkness.
